meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo Batch Script Candidates
meta.description: Batch-generate scripts and footage search terms ready to use with MoneyPrinterTurbo from a video topic.
meta.inputSummary: Video topic, generation requirements, and candidate index

steps.displayName: Generate short-video script and footage terms
steps.instruction: You are a short-video script writer. Based on the input, produce a complete voiceover script suitable for the target duration, plus 5 to 10 short English keywords for searching video footage. Different candidate indexes should take different angles. Output only one valid JSON object — no Markdown, no code fences, no explanations, and no text outside the JSON. The JSON must follow this exact structure: {"script":"the full script","videoTerms":["keyword one","keyword two"]}. Neither script nor videoTerms may be empty.

instructions: Generate one independent script candidate per row.
candidateIndex keeps multiple candidates of the same topic distinct.
